title: Explore
summary: Understand and research the project, the user, the business market, and the wide context. Gather information, empathize, and find inspiration.
activities: Research references, competitors, and similar products

details.Outcomes: Mindmaps, Hand drawn sketches, Whiteboard sessions, Paper and pencil

title: Define
summary: Synthesize exploration findings to frame the problem and sketch early solutions. Shape user flows, interactions, and screen structure.

title: Design
summary: Bring ideas to life. Create high-fidelity prototypes, test with users, gather feedback, and refine.
activities: Create design systems and style guides

details.Outcomes: High-fidelity prototypes, Interactive mockups, Design systems, Style guides

title: Integrate
summary: Merge designs with development. Validate in context, refine based on feedback, and prepare for launch.
activities: Refine based on user and team feedback

details.Outcomes: Usability testing, User feedback loops, Design iteration

title: Deliver
summary: Launch the product, monitor performance, collect feedback, and iterate. Continuous delivery enables continuous improvement.
activities: Deploy to users via CI/CD pipeline
Collect user feedback for next iteration

details.Outcomes: Production deployment, Analytics dashboards, Feedback collection
details.Methods: Post-launch monitoring, Continuous improvement, User feedback loops
